title: Remove the unused control connection store read
outcome: Remove the unused host-private control_connection_read operation and its store-identity code. TermAl reconciles a specific operation through its successor store with no call to this operation, confirmed in Fable2 mailbox ebe242f7 #8587 on TermAl master 63cdb11774c6748c3b8b523f574b9b36d6ebc129.
acceptance: Remove control_connection_read from the request enum, handler, operation-specific refusal, diagnostics, dedicated tests, and protocol documentation. Add no replacement operation.
Keep only canonical_store_path and store_path_text in store_file.rs and preserve their existing readiness and doctor behavior. Keep any independent live caller of connection supersession validation.
An old control_connection_read wire request receives the ordinary unknown-request refusal. A behavior test verifies that path.
Add no check, flag, schema, or identity mechanism.
